title: Майбутнє в минулому
explanation:
**was / were going to** + V: *I was going to call.* · − *I wasn't going to tell anyone.*
**would** + V: *She said she would come.* · − *I knew he **wouldn't** agree.*
**was / were about to** + V: *We were about to leave.*
**was / were supposed to** + V: *You were supposed to buy bread.* · − *We weren't supposed to tell.*

Після *when, before, until* у такому реченні — Past Simple: *He promised he'd call when he **got** home.*

guide.idea: Ми переносимося в минуле й кажемо, що тоді було ще попереду: план, обіцянка, прогноз. Найчастіше — щоб пояснити, чому план не здійснився, або переказати чиїсь слова.

use.note: was going to + «але…» — найчастіший спосіб пояснити чи виправдатися.
use.en: I was going to call you, but my phone died.
use.uk: Я збирався тобі подзвонити, але телефон розрядився.

use.note: would після said, promised, thought, knew — колишнє will з погляду минулого.
use.en: Tom promised he would fix the tap at the weekend.
use.uk: Том пообіцяв, що полагодить кран на вихідних.

use.note: would у розповіді: що чекало попереду, ми вже знаємо.
use.en: I never thought I would end up living in Leeds.
use.uk: Я й не думав, що врешті житиму в Лідсі.

use.note: was about to + when — щось перервало дію в останню мить.
use.en: I was about to go to bed when the doorbell rang.
use.uk: Я вже збирався лягати, коли подзвонили у двері.

use.note: was supposed to — домовленість, розклад чи обов'язок, які не виконали.
use.en: The parcel was supposed to arrive yesterday.

vs.title: was going to чи was supposed to?

a.en: I was going to clean the flat.

b.en: I was supposed to clean the flat.
b.note: Цього від мене чекали інші — домовленість чи обов'язок.

b.uk: Вона сказала, що подзвонить сьогодні ввечері.
b.note: will можна лишити, лише якщо подія ще попереду й досі актуальна.

mistakes.wrong: I thought you will like it.
mistakes.right: I thought you would like it.
mistakes.why: «Я думав, що тобі сподобається» — думка з минулого, тому would; українська тут час не змінює.

mistakes.wrong: The train must arrive at 8, but it was late.
mistakes.right: The train was supposed to arrive at 8, but it was late.
mistakes.why: «Мав прибути» за розкладом — was supposed to; must — це обов'язок зараз.

mistakes.wrong: I was going to call you, but I have forgotten.
mistakes.right: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
mistakes.why: Уся розповідь у минулому — Past Simple, а не Present Perfect.

formula: was/were **about to** + V — ось-ось · was/were **supposed to** + V — мало бути

head: Форма
Значення
Приклад
rows: We were going to fly, but we took the train.
He promised he would fix it.
I was about to go to bed when you texted.
You were supposed to buy bread!
They didn't know they were to meet again.

examples.en: I was going to cook dinner, but we ended up ordering sushi.
examples.uk: Я збирався приготувати вечерю, але врешті ми замовили суші.

examples.en: Emma said she would meet me at the station.
examples.uk: Емма сказала, що зустріне мене на вокзалі.

examples.en: I never imagined I would enjoy cooking so much.
examples.uk: Я й не уявляв, що мені так сподобається готувати.

examples.en: We were just about to leave when it started pouring.
examples.uk: Ми якраз збиралися виходити, коли почалася злива.

examples.en: The plumber was supposed to come on Monday.
I knew this winter was going to be long.
examples.uk: Я знав, що ця зима буде довгою.

tip: *was going to* — **мій** намір; *was supposed to* — **зовнішній** план чи обов'язок. *I was going to clean* — я збирався прибрати; *I was supposed to clean* — від мене цього чекали (а я не зробив).

exercises.prompt: I ___ call you last night, but my phone died.
exercises.explanation: Намір у минулому, який не здійснився.

exercises.prompt: She promised she ___ help us, but she never came.
exercises.explanation: Майбутнє з погляду минулого після promised → would.

exercises.prompt: We were ___ to leave when the taxi driver called to say he was stuck in traffic.
The parcel ___ arrive on Tuesday, but it's Friday and it still isn't here.
exercises.explanation: Мало бути за планом: was supposed to.

exercises.prompt: We ___ (go) to Brighton last weekend, but Emma got sick. (намір, 4 слова)
answer: were going to go
exercises.explanation: Нездійснений план → were going to + V.

exercises.prompt: He said he ___ (be) home by ten. (2 слова)
answer: would be
'd be

exercises.prompt: I ___ (about / fall) asleep when the neighbours started drilling. (4 слова)
answer: was about to fall
exercises.explanation: Ось-ось мало статися → was about to.

exercises.prompt: You ___ (supposed / text) me when you landed! (4 слова)
answer: were supposed to text
exercises.explanation: Очікувалося, але не зроблено → were supposed to.

exercises.sentence: I was going to calling you, but I got busy.
She told me she will be late, so I waited.

answer: I was just about to text you.
I was just about to write to you.
I was about to text you.

exercises.prompt: "I'll fix the tap tomorrow," he said.
exercises.instruction: Перепишіть у непряму мову, почніть з He said…
answer: He said he would fix the tap the next day.
He said that he would fix the tap the next day.
He said he would fix the tap the following day.
He said that he would fix the tap the following day.
He said he would fix the tap tomorrow.
He said that he would fix the tap tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: will → would, tomorrow → the next day.

exercises.uk: Ми мали зустрітися о сьомій, але вона не прийшла.
answer: We were supposed to meet at seven, but she didn't come.
We were supposed to meet at seven, but she didn't show up.
We were supposed to meet at 7, but she didn't come.
We were supposed to meet at seven, but she never came.
We were going to meet at seven, but she didn't come.
We were supposed to meet at seven o'clock, but she didn't come.
We were supposed to meet at seven, but she didn't turn up.
exercises.explanation: Домовленість, що не здійснилася → were supposed to.
